metadata.question: Does the total number of lakes in northern Siberia east of the Taz River decrease in 2002 compared to 1973?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Landsat surface reflectance (LS5 1973+, LS7 1999+). We need circa 1973 and 2002. LS8/9 are not usable for 1973; LS5 starts ~1984, so 1973 closest is 1975-1979. - Date: epoch1 = 1973-01-01 … 1975-12-31 (widened to get LS5 imagery near 1973), epoch2 = 2002-01-01 … 2002-12-31. - Location: northern Siberia east of the Taz River. I will centre on the permafrost Yamal/Gydan lowlands (~70-72°N, 75-80°E), well east of the Taz. A 200×200 km box centered on 71°N, 78°E covers thousands of thermokarst lakes. 2. Masking strategy: - Objective: map open-water pixels (lakes) for each year with the same sensor, land/water mask, then count total detected lakes after connected-component analysis. - Cloud mask via QA_PIXEL, then simple NDWI (or MNDWI ) threshold > 0.3 to pick open water, clean small artefacts (area > 0.3 ha ≈ 3 pixels at 30 m), and apply connectedPixelCount > 3. 3. Logic: - If either epoch has 0 images → C1 - After processing, total lake objects = 0 in the epoch? → C2 - Compute lake count: n73 and n02; compare 2002 < 1973 → yes → A, else → B. ```python import ee, math, collections ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. ROI & epochs roi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([75, 70, 80, 72]) # northern W-Siberia, east of Taz R. epoch1 = ('1973-01-01', '1975-12-31') # closest Landsat to 1973 epoch2 = ('2002-01-01', '2002-12-31') # 2. Helpers def maskL5L7(img): qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL') cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<5)) return img.updateMask(cloud.Not()) def mapWater(img): mndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B2','SR_B5']).rename('water') # (Green-SWIR1)/(Green+SWIR1) return mndwi.gt(0.3).selfMask().copyProperties(img,['system:time_start']) def countLakes(year, imgs): # run connected-objects, return number of lakes imgs = imgs.filterBounds(roi).map(maskL5L7).map(mapWater) if imgs.size().getInfo() ==0: return None mosaic = imgs.mosaic().gt(0) # binary water mask # connected components (8-neighbor), keep segments ≥3 pixels (0.3 ha) objects = mosaic.connectedComponents(connectedness=ee.Kernel.plus(1), maxSize=1024) lakes = objects.expression( "b(0) == 1 && b(1) >= 3 && b(1) < 1023" , {'b0':mosaic,'b1':objects.select('labels')} ).selfMask() # count distinct label ids = number of lakes counts = lakes.addBands(objects.select('labels')) \ .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.countDistinct(), geometry=roi, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('labels') return counts.getInfo() # 3. Acquire collections col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LM05/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(*epoch1) col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(*epoch2) print("L5 1975 images:", col1.size().getInfo()) print("L7 2002 images:", col2.size().getInfo()) if col1.size().getInfo()==0 or col2.size().getInfo()==0: print("<C1") import sys; sys.exit() n73 = countLakes("1973", col1) n02 = countLakes("2002", col2) if n73 is None or n02 is None: print("<C3") import sys; sys.exit() print("Lakes 1973:", n73) print("Lakes 2002:", n02) if n02 < n73: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee, math, collections
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. ROI & epochs
roi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([75, 70, 80, 72])  # northern W-Siberia, east of Taz R.
epoch1 = ('1973-01-01', '1975-12-31')   # closest Landsat to 1973
epoch2 = ('2002-01-01', '2002-12-31')

# 2. Helpers
def maskL5L7(img):
    qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
    cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<5))
    return img.updateMask(cloud.Not())

def mapWater(img):
    mndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B2','SR_B5']).rename('water')   # (Green-SWIR1)/(Green+SWIR1)
    return mndwi.gt(0.3).selfMask().copyProperties(img,['system:time_start'])

def countLakes(year, imgs):  # run connected-objects, return number of lakes
    imgs = imgs.filterBounds(roi).map(maskL5L7).map(mapWater)
    if imgs.size().getInfo() ==0: return None
    mosaic = imgs.mosaic().gt(0)  # binary water mask
    # connected components (8-neighbor), keep segments ≥3 pixels (0.3 ha)
    objects = mosaic.connectedComponents(connectedness=ee.Kernel.plus(1), maxSize=1024)
    lakes = objects.expression(
        "b(0) == 1 && b(1) >= 3 && b(1) < 1023" ,
        {'b0':mosaic,'b1':objects.select('labels')}
    ).selfMask()
    # count distinct label ids = number of lakes
    counts = lakes.addBands(objects.select('labels')) \
                  .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.countDistinct(), geometry=roi, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9) \
                  .get('labels')
    return counts.getInfo()

# 3. Acquire collections
col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LM05/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(*epoch1)
col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(*epoch2)
print("L5 1975 images:", col1.size().getInfo())
print("L7 2002 images:", col2.size().getInfo())

if col1.size().getInfo()==0 or col2.size().getInfo()==0:
    print("<<answer>C1</answer>")
    import sys; sys.exit()

n73 = countLakes("1973", col1)
n02 = countLakes("2002", col2)
if n73 is None or n02 is None:
    print("<<answer>C3</answer>")
    import sys; sys.exit()

print("Lakes 1973:", n73)
print("Lakes 2002:", n02)
if n02 < n73:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
